rules.article: Article 1: All Locks shall be yours, without outside consultation.
Article 2: All picks are due by Sunday at 12:00 PM (noon) Central Time. Picks for earlier games lock at their kickoff. Saved lines remain fixed even if the market changes.
Article 3: Failure to submit timely picks will result in a loss for the category(ies) applicable for the missing picks

Article 4: All picks must be from NFL games on the given week of Wednesday-Sunday using FanDuel and DraftKings lines. No Monday Night Football bets are allowed so a winner can be determined by Sunday night.
Article 5a: Super Locks must be -120 or more difficult. (Ex -115, +105 would qualify) (-160 or -125 would not qualify)
Article 5b: No Parlays are allowed for any bet.
Article 6a:The weekly winner receives a $5 Venmo from all other league members, which is paid out by Jared.

Article 6b: The weekly winner will take home $35 for the week. $5 must be used on a single Thursday Night Football group Same Game Parlay and $5 must be used on a single Monday Night Football group Same Game Parlay.

Article 7: The weekly tiebreaker will be decided by the following:
1.) The individual who hits their Super Lock. 
2.) The individual with the more difficult Super Lock. 
3.) The individual with the better winning percentage for that respective season. 
4.) The individual with the all time overall record.
Article 8a: Line adjustments may be made as long as a new "bet" is acknowledged in this sheet. Acknowledgement must include the new spread or odds and what platform it was discovered on.

Article 8b: If a line adjustment is made, any league member may call the bettor out if they believe it's not accurate. A screenshot is required otherwise that bet is considered a loss if a new bet can't be made in time.

Article 9: Boosted odds are not eligilbe for Super Lock bets or enhanced odds should the tiebreaker come into play. Sportsbook offered boosts may be used for Super Lock bets; however, the original odds pre-boost must meet the minimum odds outlined in Article 5a.
Article 10: An individual can not use the same bet for a Super Lock. The individual who places the bet beforehand is awarded that bet. Different odds does not mean it's a different bet
Article 11a: Each member will pay a $100 entry fee before the season starts.
Article 11b: The $100 entry fee is paid via our LeagueSafe account and is due by August 31st, 2023 otherwise there's a $25 late fee or your spot can be filled.

Article 11c: At the conclusion of the regular season, the payout will be the following:
1st Place = $500
2nd Place = $200
3rd Place = $100
Article 12a The winner is the individual with the most wins rather than the best win percentages. Ex.) Ties don't mean anything other than to support with a tiebreaker to separate loss totals.

Article 12b The season long record tiebreaker will be decided by the following:
1.) The individual with the best record for their Super Lock bets.
2.) The individual with the longer total odds of their Super Lock bets.
3.) The individual with the longer total odds of their Super Lock bets that hit.
